title: Conjugate Rationalization of a Square Root Limit
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar

steps.title: Multiply by the Conjugate
steps.explanation: Multiply numerator and denominator by the radical conjugate sqrt(x+4) + 2.
steps.why: Conjugate multiplication rationalizes the numerator via (A - B)(A + B) = A^2 - B^2.

steps.title: Cancel Common Factor x
steps.explanation: Cancel the variable x from numerator and denominator.
steps.why: Removing x eliminates the 0 in the denominator.

steps.title: Compute the Limit via Direct Substitution
steps.explanation: Substitute x = 0 into the rationalized expression.
steps.why: The rationalized function is continuous at x = 0.
